fit_linear_references: fit linear element references for target properties using a dataset and least squares regression
create_element_references: create a LinearReferences module from a .pt or .npz file or state dictionary
load_references_from_config: load element references from a configuration dictionary with optional dataset fitting
apply_refs_ElementReferences: apply element reference normalization by subtracting reference values from a tensor batch
dereference_LinearReferences: remove linear element references from a target tensor using batch-wise index addition
